fold_gaps: 🌊's gate-3 ruling rules the fire only and does not fold the corpus verdict; the row doc makes folding a reviewed coordinator step at j12′, in which the reviewer checks each trace file (the collector does not sign it).

The 13 case receipts are sealed hmac-sha256-proof-observer-key-v1 with the run owner's key. This lane does not hold it: its regrade reproduces PASS-candidate only on the assumption that the signatures hold (MISSING-candidate with any other key).
The row's method (manifest, control, grader) is on draft docs#620 at 6e1da8eb, not on docs main, so this corpus's own docs base cannot judge the receipts.
openclaw#1271 orders exact-head readiness on all six seats before live acceptance proof; no seat runs a22bd9c05c. Whether an isolated-gateway row is exempt is 🌊's call.
rows.summary: Ruled whole-13 run rra-e0b97a595e89973b at docs 6e1da8eb, product a22bd9c05c: every gate true, every buildInfoCommit a22bd9c05c, clean teardown. Graded as if the observer-key signatures hold (this lane does not hold the key; 🌊 ruled on 🕯's signed receipts), all 13 cases are PASS-candidate and the 10 fired delegates correlate with their Tempo traces. Not folded: the state stays missing, the seed state F′ kept for every row until its reviewed fold, because the row's own grader returns MISSING-candidate until the receipts are verified with the observer key. This is not a behavior finding.
rows.last_known_good: NEW-ROW-NO-PRIOR-PASS: no corpus has folded this row. Earlier owner runs stay their SHA's and are not carried: rra-88e4fd22f0b122a8 and rra-a4d5318d426ad728 (2907e656, refused by the a22b pin); rra-eaa61a458beaf344, rra-3dd1c2a556ae087f and rra-89f6172167abb906 (a22bd9c05c, each MISSING).
